headline: Gitlawb Unifies AI Coding Agents into a Single Terminal Interface
lede: Modern developer workflows are often fragmented across disparate AI model APIs and isolated tools. This interface centralizes file management, shell execution, and session state to transform the command line into a robust, model-agnostic operating environment.

headline: A New Toolkit Brings Human-in-the-Loop Integrity to AI Academic Writing
lede: Research integrity remains a primary concern as AI agents take on increasingly complex drafting roles. This toolkit enforces structural rigor and citation audits to ensure that literature reviews and scientific drafts remain grounded in verifiable evidence.

headline: OpenMAIC Orchestrates Multi-Agent Systems for Interactive Educational Experiences
lede: By automating the conversion of static documents into dynamic, persona-driven curricula, this platform streamlines the creation of personalized learning content. The modular architecture enables educators to deploy interactive sessions across messaging platforms without vendor lock-in.

headline: Invidious Restores Control to YouTube Viewing Through Decentralized Instances
lede: Privacy-conscious users are reclaiming their browsing experience by bypassing intrusive tracking and forced advertising. This project provides a lightweight, ad-free alternative that respects user data sovereignty while maintaining essential functionality.

headline: MiniMind Simplifies Small-Scale Language Model Training on Consumer Hardware
lede: Demystifying large language models requires moving beyond high-level abstractions toward transparent, algorithmic implementations. This project provides a complete training pipeline for 64M-parameter models, proving that functional AI research remains accessible to individual creators.

headline: Manim Powers Programmatic Mathematical Storytelling Through Python Animation
lede: Precision in visual communication is achieved when equations and geometries are rendered through reproducible code rather than manual frame manipulation. This engine continues to define the standard for high-quality, logic-driven educational media.

headline: PDF-Inspector Accelerates Document Processing with Heuristic Analysis
lede: Heavy OCR processes are often unnecessary for text-rich document streams, yet they frequently create significant infrastructure bottlenecks. This high-performance Rust library optimizes document pipelines by performing rapid classification and extraction with sub-200ms latency.

headline: Video-Use Adapts Agentic Frameworks for Conversational Video Post-Production
lede: Manual timeline manipulation is being superseded by conversational, strategy-driven editing workflows. This framework treats video as structured data, automating complex post-production tasks through agent-led reasoning and self-evaluation loops.

headline: A Standardized Skill Library Integrates AI Agents into Scientific Workflows
lede: Bridging the gap between high-level reasoning and specialized scientific tooling requires robust, portable integration standards. This library provides validated skills across multiple disciplines to ensure that AI-driven research remains reliable and privacy-compliant.

headline: Patent-Disclosure-Skill Simplifies Technical Documentation for R&D Engineers
lede: Drafting patent applications is a notoriously complex task that often excludes technical innovators from protecting their own work. This CLI-integrated toolkit modularizes the patent lifecycle, allowing developers to generate professional disclosure documents via natural language.
